text:
mike: Quick check — are we still planning to cut the release branch at 10:00am PT tomorrow? I have the SDK docs regen queued but want to avoid a race with the console site deploy.
lauren: Yes 10:00am PT stands unless something blocks. Can you confirm the changelog PR is green?
sarah: changelog PR #452 is open, awaiting final sign-off from product. No code changes expected, just bulleted features.
james: Heads-up: if we cut at 10am I need the release tag bumped before the SDK docs regen job runs. Otherwise the published docs will point to the old tag.
mike: Got it. Plan: I'll tag at 9:50am PT, push branch cut at 10:00am, then trigger SDK docs regen at 10:10am. Sounds safe?
lauren: That timing works. Can someone add a quick comment on #452 to unblock product review? @sarah
sarah: Done — pinged product and added the QA checklist items. They responded with a :thumbsup: and said they'll get to it first thing.
release-bot: Deploy window reminder: scheduled maintenance window tomorrow 10:00-11:00 PT. Please ensure jobs that must not run during the window are paused.
docs-ci: SDK docs regen job (sdk-docs:regen) queued. To avoid collision, set env SKIP_DEPLOY=true if you want only the artifact built.
james: Thanks for the tip. I'll set SKIP_DEPLOY=false after the tag goes out so the published site updates.
mike: One more ask — if anyone lands a last-minute change after 9:30am, cc me in the PR so I can assess risk before we cut.
lauren: Noted. I'll also add a line in the release notes draft to call out the SDK version bump and console changes.
sarah: If product signs off before 9:30am we'll be golden. If not, we should consider a 2-hour delay rather than a rollback.
mike: Agreed. I'll post a final status update here at 9:40am PT with the tag name and a link to the changelog PR.
release-bot: Automated reminder set for 9:40am PT to this thread.
lauren: Thanks all — appreciate the coordination. :rocket:
